property_summary: Only the externally supplied caller (msg.sender) can become the rewardDistributor after setRewardDistributor is called (i.e., rewardDistributor equals tx.origin only if tx.origin == msg.sender, otherwise it equals the provided _distributor).
change_summary: Change setRewardDistributor to require onlyOwner removed and instead set rewardDistributor to tx.origin, allowing distributor to be overridden to the transaction origin rather than provided argument.
